items.headline: Nike's logo-free Vomero Plus gets bubblegum soles
items.caption: The 'Sea Glass' runner pairs a plain wavy upper with pink ZoomX soles.
body: No Swoosh, just grey, black and cream.
The stacked foam soles come in pink and black.
How to wear it: with grey sweats or wide jeans.

items.headline: adidas turns the Grand Court into a Mary Jane
items.caption: The slim tennis sneaker swaps laces for a strap.
body: adidas has done the same to the Samba and Tokyo.
Soft leather uppers make it feel like a ballet flat.
How to wear it: with cropped trousers and bright socks.

items.headline: atmos makes a jade Air Jordan 12
items.caption: A black-and-jade pair marks the shoe's 30th birthday.
body: Half quilted black leather, half jade pebbled leather.
atmos is known for its jade and animal-print sneakers.
How to wear it: keep the rest of the outfit black.

items.headline: Why some T-shirts cost luxury prices
items.caption: Seven deep-cut brands for a better tee.
body: Cotton weight, sleeve length and fit make all the difference.
The T-shirt is luxury you wear every day.
How to wear it: one great white tee under a blazer.

items.headline: Casino Royale at 20: the holiday clothes beat the suits
items.caption: Daniel Craig's Bond is the best guide for a sunny winter trip.
body: Casino Royale turns 20 on November 16.
It started Craig's run as Bond.
How to wear it: a short-sleeve shirt, slim trousers and loafers.

items.headline: Haven and Converse make a Chuck 70 for real life
items.caption: The Canadian brand's second Converse collab looks lived-in already.
body: Haven is known for waterproof, practical clothing from Vancouver.
Their first team-up sold out.
How to wear it: with a shell jacket and cargo trousers.

items.headline: How to buy a winter coat if you're short
items.caption: Before sizing down, read this.
body: Coats on 6'3" models can reach a shorter man's ankles.
GQ asked buyers and stylists for fixes.
How to wear it: check the hem lands above the knee and sleeves at the wrist.

items.headline: The saga of Jensen Huang's fake Saint Laurent jacket
items.caption: A viral photo of him in studded YSL leather was fake.
body: The internet loved the look.
Esquire explains why it was too good to be true.
Style lesson: a signature jacket says a lot, real or not.

items.headline: 7 desert boots that can handle winter
items.caption: Chukkas built for slush and rain, not just sunshine.
body: Lighter than heavy winter boots.
Smarter than sneakers.
How to wear it: with dark denim or wool trousers.

items.headline: The best-dressed men at Chanel's Sydney show
items.caption: Chanel brought its Cruise 26-27 show to Barangaroo.
body: Front-row men included Joel Edgerton, Baz Luhrmann and Dom Dolla.
Chanel under Matthieu Blazy is winning over men.
Style lesson: relaxed tailoring works at any show.

items.headline: Studio Underd0g's first calendar watch
items.caption: The new 04Series shows the weekend and a retrograde date.
body: It's a whole new collection for the brand.
The date hand sweeps back at month's end.
Style lesson: a fun dial loosens up a serious outfit.

items.headline: March LA.B's '70s surf-inspired Mansart
items.caption: A French watch mixing L.A., Biarritz surf and Paris style.
body: Hodinkee went hands-on with the Small Second.
The look is straight out of the '70s.
Style lesson: pair it with a knit polo.

items.headline: World-first marrow transplant from a donor treats aplastic anemia
items.caption: Doctors used bone marrow from a deceased donor on a non-cancer disease.
body: Franciscan Health treated a 40-year-old woman with severe aplastic anemia.
Her disease had stopped responding to medicine.

items.headline: Airbnb's founder gives $100M to San Francisco parks
items.caption: Brian Chesky's gift is the city's largest ever from one donor.
body: It will speed up park building and upgrades.
Chesky calls it giving back to the city that made Airbnb possible.

items.headline: An 81-year-old finds his Canadian family after 80 years
items.caption: A DNA test linked Rodney Anderson to his WWII soldier father's family.
body: His mother had him with a visiting Canadian soldier.
A curious niece helped connect the two families.

items.headline: A 100-year-old 'store mom' gets her first birthday party
items.caption: Lowe's staff surprised Gretchen Sollo, who walks the store daily.
body: She's walked about 1,500 miles in its aisles over five years.
Staff race her and count her laps.
